title: Streetblend
description: Two-player camouflage hide-and-seek using public-domain paintings from the Art Institute of Chicago Open Access collection.

artwork.delivery: Curated public-domain Wikimedia thumbnail files; no runtime artwork API dependency.
artwork.fallback: CORS image load first, then normal image load so rendering still works if pixel access is blocked.

loading_behavior: Round timer starts only after the scene image has loaded; remote matches wait for both players to report scene readiness.
hider_controls: Gesture-first: drag figure to place, pinch figure to resize/rotate, drag background to pan, pinch background to zoom, plus Sample/Paint/Pose/Lock controls.
seeker_controls: Quick tap guesses, drag pans, pinch zooms. Wrong guesses remove 5 seconds and do not directly subtract score points.

controls.hider: Drag figure to place; pinch figure to resize/rotate; drag background to pan; pinch background to zoom; Sample/Paint/Pose/Lock buttons.
controls.seeker: Quick tap guesses; drag pans; pinch zooms.
